verdict.rationale: Bento's FAQ says natural-language alert rules compile to trace queries and can route to a webhook destination, alongside Slack, PagerDuty and email. That is a first-party outbound HTTP callback, but the evidence covers only a one-line mention scoped to alert firings, not a general event-subscription system. Missing for 10: webhook registration/configuration docs, payload schema, documented event types beyond alerts, signing/retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
